note: Weakestmo grounds thin-air reads with event structures and is, in the authors' words, 'stronger than C11 (which allows OOTA) and weaker than RC11': every separating outcome (the OOTA load-buffering test and the 'RNG' bogus-value example) is allowed by C11 and forbidden by Weakestmo, with no behaviour Weakestmo allows that C11 forbids. So C11 is strictly weaker. (Reclassified from incomparable; see litmus/strictly-weaker/Weakestmo-vs-C11.)
